mods.name: The Vaporware Pack
mods.author: abc/xyz
mods.description:
This Pack contains files for stages, characters, and bosses
It is filled with stuff that took inspiration from the vaporware concept
Until Ultimate modding becomes easier and supports material edits I will be on that asap
It Includes:
- Ocean Samus with complete UI
- Black Ice Roy, which was made before this
- Ice Sonic, with Ui made by StankKnight
- Caribbean Ike
- Caribbean Sheik
- FFVII Lantern Cloud (Turquoise)
- Ice Yoshi
- Also Includes unfinished projects (most are finished but without csps)
I will also try to update skins now that I can, but not frequently
If there are any problems
concerns 
tell me
have a nice day
